title: Application of rare earth elements in dual-modality molecular probes
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38480-38490
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA04987J, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jie-Fang He, Wen-Wen Yang, Wen-Xuan Quan, Yue-Chun Yang, Zhengwei Zhang, Qing-Ying Luo
Properties of REEs, including prolonged fluorescence lifetimes, large Stokes shifts and strong resistance to photobleaching, enhance the diagnostic capabilities of dual-modality molecular probes based on MRI. These applications encompass combinations with optical imaging, PET, CT and ultrasound.
